select id, provider_id, model, endpoint, source, outcome, http_status, error_class, streaming, duration_ms, first_byte_ms, first_token_ms, stream_complete_ms, trace_id, ucid, started_at from internal_model_call_records
order by started_at desc, id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) as sample_count, cast(min(first_token_ms) as double precision) as minimum_ms, percentile_cont(0.25) within group (order by first_token_ms) as first_quartile_ms, percentile_cont(0.50) within group (order by first_token_ms) as median_ms, percentile_cont(0.75) within group (order by first_token_ms) as third_quartile_ms, cast(max(first_token_ms) as double precision) as maximum_ms from internal_model_call_records
and first_token_ms is not null
mapper.insert: insert into internal_model_probe_status( provider_id, last_outcome, last_http_status, last_error_class, last_duration_ms, last_probed_at, last_success_at, consecutive_failures, trace_id, updated_at ) values ( #{providerId}, #{lastOutcome}, #{lastHttpStatus}, #{lastErrorClass}, #{lastDurationMillis}, #{lastProbedAt}, case when #{lastOutcome} = 'SUCCESS' then cast(#{lastProbedAt} as timestamp) else null end, case when #{lastOutcome} = 'SUCCESS' then 0 else 1 end, #{traceId}, current_timestamp ) on conflict (provider_id) do update set last_outcome = excluded.last_outcome, last_http_status = excluded.last_http_status, last_error_class = excluded.last_error_class, last_duration_ms = excluded.last_duration_ms, last_probed_at = excluded.last_probed_at, last_success_at = case when excluded.last_outcome = 'SUCCESS' then cast(excluded.last_probed_at as timestamp) else internal_model_probe_status.last_success_at end, consecutive_failures = case when excluded.last_outcome = 'SUCCESS' then 0 else internal_model_probe_status.consecutive_failures + 1 end, trace_id = excluded.trace_id, updated_at = current_timestamp

merge into internal_model_probe_status target using (values ( #{providerId}, #{lastOutcome}, #{lastHttpStatus}, #{lastErrorClass}, #{lastDurationMillis}, #{lastProbedAt}, #{traceId} )) incoming(provider_id, last_outcome, last_http_status, last_error_class, last_duration_ms, last_probed_at, trace_id) on target.provider_id = incoming.provider_id when matched then update set last_outcome = incoming.last_outcome, last_http_status = incoming.last_http_status, last_error_class = incoming.last_error_class, last_duration_ms = incoming.last_duration_ms, last_probed_at = incoming.last_probed_at, last_success_at = case when incoming.last_outcome = 'SUCCESS' then cast(incoming.last_probed_at as timestamp) else target.last_success_at end, consecutive_failures = case when incoming.last_outcome = 'SUCCESS' then 0 else target.consecutive_failures + 1 end, trace_id = incoming.trace_id, updated_at = current_timestamp when not matched then insert ( provider_id, last_outcome, last_http_status, last_error_class, last_duration_ms, last_probed_at, last_success_at, consecutive_failures, trace_id, updated_at ) values ( incoming.provider_id, incoming.last_outcome, incoming.last_http_status, incoming.last_error_class, incoming.last_duration_ms, incoming.last_probed_at, case when incoming.last_outcome = 'SUCCESS' then cast(incoming.last_probed_at as timestamp) else null end, case when incoming.last_outcome = 'SUCCESS' then 0 else 1 end, incoming.trace_id, current_timestamp )
